scenes.headline: Spark SQL Functions
scenes.subtitle: The built-in library for column expressions.
scenes.narration: The functions module provides a rich library of built-in operations for transforming columns.

scenes.headline: What the library offers
items: String, date, math, and null-handling functions
Faster and safer than custom Python UDFs
scenes.narration: The library covers string, date, math, and null-handling functions, plus aggregates and collections. It is conventionally imported as F, and its built-in functions run faster and more safely than custom Python UDFs.

scenes.headline: Composing built-in functions
scenes.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

df.select(
    F.upper(F.col("name")).alias("name"),
    F.to_date(F.col("ts")).alias("day"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("score"), F.lit(0)).alias("score")
).show()
scenes.narration: We uppercase the name, convert a timestamp to a date, and use coalesce to replace null scores with zero. Composing these built-in functions expresses rich transformations concisely while staying entirely within Spark's optimized engine.

scenes.text: Reach for a built-in function before writing a UDF — it is almost always faster.
scenes.narration: Always check for a built-in function before writing a UDF, because the native functions are almost always faster and safer.
